subject: design/existing-repo-onboarding-v2
statement: both faces are exposed as callables independent of `Run`. The **read** is near-existing — converge already offers a write-free classification callable (`Drift`, running the shared scan predicate) — so exposing it for `adopt` is trivial. The **write** is not yet separable: the per-class writes live inline in `Run`'s loop (entangled with archive acquisition and per-file manifest re-hash), so this design **exposes archive-backed engine-verbatim and generated write primitives** (returning the action set) extracted from that loop — a real, named converge change, not merely the read exposure. `adopt` consumes the classification findings **plus the generated-class desired bytes and the verified archive** (not the finding set alone) and never invokes `Run` (`design-brainstorm:…#S-1`); `Run` itself is not extended with adoption semantics (§3.7).
